title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.16285v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore,

translated_title: 基于深度引导协同建模的音频-视觉分割
translated_abstract: 音频-视觉分割（AVS）是多模态感知中的一项基础任务，通过利用视觉和音频线索，对视频中的发声物体进行像素级分割。它在视频理解、人机交互和自动驾驶等领域具有广泛应用。然而，现有的大多数AVS方法未明确建模相对距离和遮挡等几何线索，从而限制了跨模态对齐的鲁棒性。在人类感知中，空间结构自然与音频-视觉证据相结合，以准确定位发声物体。受此启发，我们将估计的深度作为空间结构线索引入AVS，并提出了DGCM-AVS，这是一个联合建模音频、视觉和深度信息的三模态框架。具体而言，我们设计了一个深度感知动态调制器，以改善相邻物体的分离，同时保持物体内部特征的一致性。此外，……
tldr: 本文提出DGCM-AVS，通过引入深度作为空间结构线索，并设计深度感知动态调制器，实现音频、视觉和深度三模态协同建模，从而提升音频-视觉分割中相邻物体分离和内部特征一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DGCM-AVS, which incorporates depth as a spatial structural cue and designs a depth-aware dynamic modulator to jointly model audio, visual, and depth information, improving adjacent object separation and intra-object feature consistency in audio-visual segmentation.
